shortDescription: Manages static routes for routing message protocol messages

options.name: description
options.description: The user-defined description of the static route.

options.name: dst_address
options.description: Specifies the destination address of the route. Setting the attribute to an empty string will create a wildcard matching all message destination-addresses, which is the default when creating a new route.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the static route.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to create route object on.

options.name: peer_selection_mode
options.description: Specifies the method to use when selecting a peer from the provided list of C(peers).

options.name: peers
options.description: Specifies a list of ltm messagerouting-peer objects. The specified peer must be on the same partition as the route.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: src_address
options.description: Specifies the source address of the route. Setting the attribute to an empty string will create a wildcard matching all message source-addresses, which is the default when creating a new route.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the route exists. When C(absent), ensures the route is removed.

options.name: type
options.description: Parameter used to specify the type of the route to manage. Default setting is C(generic) with more options coming.
